title: Home
primaryCopy: Prepare and verify CRM data from files.
information: Explain the agency buyer, available modes, exact delivery and customer-owned target import.
actions: Assess a project; view synthetic sample; read pricing.
exceptions: A suspended mode has no purchase action; existing-customer support remains visible.

title: How it works
primaryCopy: From source files to a reviewed import package.
information: Separate upload, audit, agency decisions, validation, payment, preparation and customer import.
actions: Review supported services; start fit assessment.
exceptions: No diagram implies the model grants approval or writes directly to production CRM.

title: Supported services
primaryCopy: Check your files and target before you start.
information: Read mode, object, operation, tool and envelope from the same capability publication as admission.
actions: Inspect the exact profile; ask a safe scope question.
exceptions: Planned/internal-only capability is unavailable for purchase, including stale marketing caches.

title: Pricing
primaryCopy: One scoped project, priced by source units.
information: Show bands, counted unit, taxes, recurrence and founding rules; distinguish previews from binding quotes.
actions: Estimate a band; create an account.
exceptions: Unqualified scope has no actionable quote; a preview reserves no promotion slot.

title: Sample delivery
primaryCopy: See a synthetic delivery package.
information: Show a labelled synthetic report, count/lineage explanation and importer guide.
actions: Open sample; understand the manifest.
exceptions: No fabricated customer logo, testimonial or actual-import claim.

title: Data handling
primaryCopy: Know what is processed and when it is deleted.
information: Explain actual isolation, model minimization, authority, retention and residual boundaries.
actions: Read processing terms; ask a security question.
exceptions: No unproved certification, anonymity or zero-retention claim.

title: Contact
primaryCopy: Describe the task; keep CRM files out of this form.
information: Collect business contact, destination, approximate band, timeline and bounded safe description.
actions: Submit the user's inquiry; continue written onboarding.
exceptions: Do not echo credentials or raw records into email; direct secure files to the product workflow.

title: Service status
primaryCopy: Current service availability.
information: Show actual approved public incident/capability summaries, observation time and next update.
actions: Open support.
exceptions: No tenant names or invented all-green state when observation is unavailable.

title: Agency setup
primaryCopy: Complete the steps needed to handle client data.
information: Separate identity, membership, legal/billing profile, agreements and MFA readiness.
actions: Complete the current prepared step; accept an intended invitation.
exceptions: Resume completed setup after reauthentication; email domain never autojoins an agency.

title: Agency switcher
primaryCopy: Choose the agency you are working with.
information: List only actual memberships and safe roles; keep current context visible.
actions: Switch context; create an eligible agency.
exceptions: Clear previous private content before loading; back/prefetch cannot reveal the old tenant.

title: Projects
primaryCopy: Your client preparation projects.
information: Show client, mode, revision, phase, meaningful event, required action, deadline and safe payment state.
actions: Create, filter and open projects.
exceptions: Empty state uses synthetic examples; restricted agencies retain support/refund/deletion routes.

title: Clients
primaryCopy: Keep each end client's work separate.
information: Show scoped labels, archive state, processing-authority readiness and safe project counts.
actions: Create client; open workspace; archive after impact review.
exceptions: Similar labels do not merge identities and archive does not mean delete.

title: Overview
primaryCopy: The current revision and next required action.
information: Show current subject, commercial state, delivery deadline and permitted actions in business language.
actions: Continue the valid step; inspect activity.
exceptions: Another-tab changes require a comparison and server refresh before consequential action.

title: Source intake
primaryCopy: Upload files, then review what Kavo found.
information: Separate upload progress, provider observation, scanner coverage, parser state and accepted bytes.
actions: Upload; resume valid session; cancel; inspect; replace before seal.
exceptions: Scanner skip says not fully checked; cancelled/expired sessions require a new explicit attempt.

title: Selection
primaryCopy: Confirm the records this project includes.
information: Show hidden/visible sheets, positional duplicate headers, formulas, exclusions and projection.
actions: Select admitted tables; resolve parser choices; confirm projection.
exceptions: A change invalidates counts; excluded content requires a visible reason.

title: Seal review
primaryCopy: Confirm this exact source revision.
information: Present selected files/tables, billable units, edges, parser settings, exclusions and retention.
actions: Seal immutable revision; return to selection.
exceptions: Unresolved selected input blocks seal; seal does not mean a funded audit started.

title: Target setup
primaryCopy: Confirm the destination and import method.
information: Show actual instance, objects/operations, metadata evidence/freshness and importer settings.
actions: Provide metadata; resolve facts; confirm exact body.
exceptions: Unknown writability/requiredness/enum limits remain Unknown and block affected scope.

title: Audit
primaryCopy: Review findings and decisions.
information: Separate full-data facts, sample illustrations, signals, proposed operations and missing authority.
actions: Open findings; review decisions; cancel active audit.
exceptions: Budget exhaustion preserves the deterministic profile and explicit incomplete interpretation.

title: Mapping
primaryCopy: Choose where each field goes and what changes.
information: Show source position, current target field, permitted choices, evidence and affected counts.
actions: Edit typed mapping; preserve/unmap; validate.
exceptions: No free-text execution bypass; invented fields and stale target facts return precise blockers.

title: Identity
primaryCopy: Similarity is a signal; merging needs a decision.
information: Show exact cluster, scoped identity proof, survivor, field conflicts and complete counts.
actions: Keep occurrences; approve a supported cluster; resolve conflicts.
exceptions: No sampled unique email becomes identity authority; consent has explicit treatment.

title: Relationships
primaryCopy: Confirm how records stay connected.
information: Show scoped endpoints, relation type, parent mapping, unresolved edges and receipt stages.
actions: Approve a representable effect; withhold/reject; inspect stages.
exceptions: Missing parents remain explicit; omitted edges cannot be shown as successful.

title: Approval
primaryCopy: Approve these exact preparation decisions.
information: Show source/target, complete validation, material CLEAR/merge/exclusion effects and limits.
actions: Step-up; approve exact disclosures; return to review.
exceptions: A hidden effect or stale version blocks approval; Enter cannot trigger an undisclosed default.

title: Quote
primaryCopy: Review price, scope and availability.
information: Show base, one discount, service, tax, total, units, terms, price/data expiry and blockers.
actions: Accept terms; create server payment order.
exceptions: Expired data offers reupload/revalidation, not Pay now; founding reservation expiry is explicit.

title: Payment
primaryCopy: Your status comes from verified payment information.
information: Show pending, confirmed, failed or checking state with safe order/support references.
actions: Refresh the same operation; contact support; continue when authorized.
exceptions: Never encourage another payment while uncertain or trust redirect success as capture.

title: Processing
primaryCopy: Your approved project is being prepared.
information: Separate queue, startup, execution, verification and publication; label estimates honestly.
actions: View progress; cancel if allowed; open support.
exceptions: Heartbeat is not completion percentage; failure/expiry shows the actual next action.

title: Delivery
primaryCopy: Download the verified package before its deadline.
information: Show immutable version, reports, files, named counts, verification and exact access endpoint.
actions: Request scoped download; view report; inspect import guide.
exceptions: Expired/revoked artifacts have no links; a correction is a new explained version.

title: Import steps
primaryCopy: Use the specified tool and settings for each stage.
information: Show dependencies, backup/recovery prerequisite, exact chunks and customer responsibility.
actions: Acknowledge guide; upload receipt; continue approved stage.
exceptions: Display AWAITING_AGENCY_IMPORT as Import step needs your result; download is not import.

title: Import results
primaryCopy: Match the actual target result to this stage.
information: Show package/instance, successful/failed/unresolved counts and child consequences.
actions: Upload securely; inspect mismatch; approve supported partial scope.
exceptions: Differing finalized receipt opens reconciliation; row position never becomes target identity.

title: Data lifecycle
primaryCopy: See what remains and what will be deleted.
information: Show data classes, soft/hard deadlines, eligible single extension and lawful residuals.
actions: Request eligible extension before expiry; request deletion; inspect status.
exceptions: No extension revives expired data or crosses a hard cap.

title: Billing
primaryCopy: Track quotes, payments, fiscal documents and refunds.
information: Show the agency's exact service/tax values, provider state and actual legal document identity.
actions: Download issued invoice; request refund; resolve billing profile.
exceptions: A local summary is not a fiscal invoice; foreign payments are inaccessible.

title: Team
primaryCopy: Give each person only the access they need.
information: Show roles, invitation state and assurance without authentication secrets.
actions: Invite; change bounded role; revoke; transfer ownership with step-up.
exceptions: Last-owner removal and forwarded-invite identity mismatch fail safely.

title: Settings
primaryCopy: Manage agency details and safe branding.
information: Separate display label, legal/billing identity, security, branding and closure.
actions: Update label/logo; follow legal-profile change; request closure.
exceptions: Renaming does not reset discounts, attribution or client identity.

title: Private home
primaryCopy: Your permitted operational and commercial work.
information: Render seller, owner and technical-operator projections by explicit capability.
actions: Open assignments, statements, health and owner queue.
exceptions: Seller sees no global cash or raw CRM; unknown balances are not zero.

title: Prospects
primaryCopy: Work only qualified, permitted opportunities.
information: Show lawful source/date, fit, assignment, suppression and next real action.
actions: Research; draft; record permitted contact; submit claim.
exceptions: Lists are not automatically qualified; suppression blocks every send route.

title: Agency relationship
primaryCopy: Assignment and acquisition entitlement are separate.
information: Show current service owner, acquisition owner, signed rates/window and safe history.
actions: Review claim; prepare reassignment or prospective assistance.
exceptions: Service reassignment cannot reset first project or erase residual rights.

title: Commissions
primaryCopy: Understand what was earned, held and paid.
information: Show basis after discount/refunds, rate/split, eligibility, holds and actual payout.
actions: Inspect statement; contest line; provide verified documents.
exceptions: Parent-stage release is not final eligibility; transfer submission is not receipt.

title: Seller lifecycle
primaryCopy: Track the actual reviewed engagement.
information: Show assessment, legal relationship, signed terms, training, access and pilot dates.
actions: Prepare activation, training, amendment or termination.
exceptions: A contractor label is not legal review; termination preserves lawful financial duties.

title: Owner actions
primaryCopy: Personal actions are prepared before they reach you.
information: Show reason, verified destination, prepared fields, minimal personal act, cost, deadline and proof.
actions: Open official flow; record safe result; report a changed screen.
exceptions: No coding/CLI/menu guessing for Miguel; unmaterialized recipe says Not ready.

title: Company finance
primaryCopy: Separate collections, cash and obligations.
information: Show capture, hold, fees, withdrawals, bank availability, tax/refund/seller liabilities and dated costs.
actions: Reconcile; prepare a reviewed payment/distribution/investment.
exceptions: No seller access to personal finance; valuation or forecast does not create spendable money.

title: Jobs
primaryCopy: Inspect safe execution and recovery facts.
information: Show logical attempt, phase, accepted version, envelope, lease and safe incident links.
actions: Prepare authorized cancel/reconcile/retry under one entitlement.
exceptions: No manual status edit overrides approval, payment or deletion authority.

title: Deletion
primaryCopy: Verify what was actually removed.
information: Show scope/classes, deadlines, tombstones, residuals and retries.
actions: Run exact authorized cleanup; inspect failure; reconcile restore journal.
exceptions: Database DELETED cannot conceal live or soft-deleted provider objects.

title: Incidents
primaryCopy: Contain the affected scope and prove recovery.
information: Show severity, known impact, containment, recovery, communication authority and next review.
actions: Prepare breakglass, recovery or notice; act only within authority.
exceptions: No invented resolution, broad access or unperformed customer message.

title: Releases
primaryCopy: Promote only the accepted exact candidate.
information: Show full code/tree/package/image/contracts/evidence, gate status and business readiness.
actions: Review concrete promotion; restrict unsafe capability; open repair.
exceptions: Stale same-named CI or new rebuilt image cannot borrow old acceptance.

title: Operating review
primaryCopy: Choose the next action from actual evidence.
information: Show cohort funnel, support burden, contribution, concentration, costs and obligations.
actions: Prepare one funded experiment/mandate with a stop rule.
exceptions: A draft is not an active automation; scenario arithmetic is not observed demand.

title: Service terms
primaryCopy: Read the scope before you buy.
information: Actual legal operator, version/date, preparation/import boundary, price/refund/retention and jurisdiction.
actions: Read accessible version history and contact the responsible operator.
exceptions: No invented entity details or retroactive replacement of accepted terms.

title: Privacy notice
primaryCopy: Understand how your information is handled.
information: Actual controller/processors, purposes, locations, periods, rights and contact.
actions: Open the applicable notice and submit a privacy request.
exceptions: No absolute deletion or jurisdictional compliance claim unsupported by actual providers.

title: Data processing terms
primaryCopy: Know the responsibilities for client data.
information: Controller/processor roles, instructions, subprocessors, safeguards and actual transfer basis.
actions: Review the agreement required for agency activation.
exceptions: Anonymous viewing is allowed; versioned agency acceptance remains authenticated.

title: Help centre
primaryCopy: Find the next step for your project.
information: File preparation, target metadata, approval, payment, import stages, receipts and retention.
actions: Search current versioned guides and open an authenticated support case.
exceptions: Public examples remain synthetic and cannot expose private case titles.

title: Communication preferences
primaryCopy: Stop optional messages.
information: Purpose-bound confirmation without disclosing unrelated account or contact facts.
actions: Suppress the applicable marketing channel immediately.
exceptions: No login prerequisite; essential service notices remain clearly separated.

title: Sign in
primaryCopy: Continue securely.
information: Available qualified identity method and safe recovery route.
actions: Sign in using an actual enabled provider; return only to allowlisted application routes.
exceptions: Generic failure does not enumerate accounts; expired session preserves safe navigation only.

title: Accept invitation
primaryCopy: Join the intended agency.
information: Inviting agency and intended role only after token and identity checks.
actions: Accept a current invitation with the matching verified identity.
exceptions: Expired, forwarded or revoked token does not grant access.

title: Support cases
primaryCopy: Track your questions and next actions.
information: Scoped case status, response commitments, attachments policy and safe evidence.
actions: Open or reply to a case within current membership permissions.
exceptions: Revoked users cannot retrieve old tenant data through case links.

title: Seller resources
primaryCopy: Use the current approved offer.
information: Versioned English offer sheets, demonstrations, objection handling, contract boundaries and superseded labels.
actions: Open current resources and prepare a permitted draft.
exceptions: Obsolete claims cannot be silently reused in a new campaign.

title: Reviewed correspondence
primaryCopy: Review exactly what will be sent.
information: Recipient, sender, provenance, content, permission, suppression and accepted/uncertain outcome.
actions: Prepare, authorize or send only through the actor-specific allowed actions.
exceptions: A draft is not sent; provider acceptance is not delivery or a reply.

title: Support operations
primaryCopy: Resolve the issue with scoped evidence.
information: Assigned cases, next response, safe diagnostic links and escalations.
actions: Reply with actual authorization or request prepared breakglass where necessary.
exceptions: Seller permission does not include raw CRM support artifacts.
